lesson_intro: Today we travel back 2000 years to the 'Golden Age' of Tamil culture—The Sangam Period. This was the time of the three great academies (Sangams) in Madurai, where thousands of poets composed masterpieces that still define Tamil identity today. We explore the 'Thinai' system—the classification of land into 5 types—and the literature of 'Ettuthokai' and 'Pattuppattu'. For a TNPSC aspirant, this is the most high-yield history block. Understanding how the Cheras, Cholas, and Pandyas lived is the key to mastering Unit 8.
